    32→// parseAndLogHookInput parses the hook input and sets up logging context.
    33→func parseAndLogHookInput() (*hookInputData, error) {
    34→	// Get the agent from the hook command context (e.g., "entire hooks claude-code ...")
    35→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
    36→	if err != nil {

    40→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
    41→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookUserPromptSubmit, os.Stdin)
    42→	if err != nil {
    43→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
    44→	}
    45→
    46→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
    47→	logging.Info(logCtx, "user-prompt-submit",
    48→		slog.String("hook", "user-prompt-submit"),
    49→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
    50→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
    51→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),

    53→
    54→	sessionID := input.SessionID

    60→	return &hookInputData{

    63→		sessionID: sessionID,
    64→	}, nil

    67→// captureInitialState captures the initial state on user prompt submit.
    68→func captureInitialState() error {
    69→	// Parse hook input and setup logging
    70→	hookData, err := parseAndLogHookInput()
    71→	if err != nil {
    72→		return err
    73→	}
    74→
    75→	// CLI captures state directly (including transcript position)
    76→	if err := CapturePrePromptState(hookData.sessionID, hookData.input.SessionRef); err != nil {
    77→		return err
    78→	}
    79→
    80→	// If a wingman review is pending, inject it as additionalContext so the
    81→	// agent addresses it BEFORE the user's request. This is the primary
    82→	// delivery mechanism — the agent sees the instruction as mandatory context.
    83→	if settings.IsWingmanEnabled() {
    84→		repoRoot, rootErr := paths.RepoRoot()
    85→		if rootErr == nil {
    86→			wingmanLogCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "wingman")
    87→			if _, statErr := os.Stat(filepath.Join(repoRoot, wingmanReviewFile)); statErr == nil {
    88→				fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Review available: .entire/REVIEW.md — injecting into context\n")
    89→				logging.Info(wingmanLogCtx, "wingman injecting review instruction on prompt-submit",
    90→					slog.String("session_id", hookData.sessionID),
    91→				)
    92→				if err := outputHookResponseWithContextAndMessage(
    93→					wingmanApplyInstruction,
    94→					"[Wingman] A code review is pending and will be addressed before your request.",
    95→				); err != nil {
    96→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Warning: failed to inject review instruction: %v\n", err)
    97→				} else {
    98→					// Hook response written to stdout — must return immediately
    99→					// to avoid corrupting the JSON with additional output.
   100→					return nil
   101→				}
   102→			}
   103→
   104→			// Notify if a review is currently in progress (fresh lock file).
   105→			// outputHookMessage writes JSON to stdout; session initialization
   106→			// below only touches disk/stderr, so there's no double-write risk.
   107→			// Uses wingmanNotificationLockThreshold (10min) — tighter than the
   108→			// 30min staleLockThreshold used for lock acquisition.
   109→			lockPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, wingmanLockFile)
   110→			if lockInfo, statErr := os.Stat(lockPath); statErr == nil && time.Since(lockInfo.ModTime()) <= wingmanNotificationLockThreshold {
   111→				logging.Info(wingmanLogCtx, "wingman review in progress",
   112→					slog.String("session_id", hookData.sessionID),
   113→				)
   114→				if err := outputHookMessage("[Wingman] Review in progress..."); err != nil {
   115→					fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Warning: failed to output review-in-progress message: %v\n", err)
   116→				}
   117→			}
   118→		}
   119→	}
   120→
   121→	// If strategy implements SessionInitializer, call it to initialize session state
   122→	strat := GetStrategy()
   123→
   124→	// Ensure strategy setup is in place (git hooks, gitignore, metadata branch).
   125→	// Done here at turn start so hooks are installed before any mid-turn commits.
   126→	if err := strat.EnsureSetup(); err != nil {
   127→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to ensure strategy setup: %v\n", err)
   128→	}
   129→
   130→	if initializer, ok := strat.(strategy.SessionInitializer); ok {
   131→		agentType := hookData.agent.Type()
   132→		if err := initializer.InitializeSession(hookData.sessionID, agentType, hookData.input.SessionRef, hookData.input.UserPrompt); err != nil {
   133→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to initialize session state: %v\n", err)
   134→		}
   135→	}
   136→
   137→	return nil
   138→}
   139→
   140→// commitWithMetadata commits the session changes with metadata.
   141→func commitWithMetadata() error { //nolint:maintidx // already present in codebase
   142→	// Get the agent for hook input parsing and session ID transformation
   143→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   144→	if err != nil {
   145→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   146→	}
   147→
   148→	// Parse hook input using agent interface
   149→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookStop, os.Stdin)
   150→	if err != nil {
   151→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   152→	}
   153→
   154→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   155→	logging.Info(logCtx, "stop",
   156→		slog.String("hook", "stop"),
   157→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   158→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   159→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.SessionRef),
   160→	)
   161→
   162→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   163→	if sessionID == "" {
   164→		sessionID = unknownSessionID
   165→	}
   166→
   167→	transcriptPath := input.SessionRef
   168→	if transcriptPath == "" || !fileExists(transcriptPath) {
   169→		return fmt.Errorf("transcript file not found or empty: %s", transcriptPath)
   170→	}
   171→
   172→	// Early check: bail out quickly if the repo has no commits yet.
   173→	// Without this, the function does a lot of work (transcript copy, prompt extraction, etc.)
   174→	// before eventually failing deep in strategy.SaveChanges().
   175→	if repo, err := strategy.OpenRepository(); err == nil && strategy.IsEmptyRepository(repo) {
   176→		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping checkpoint. Will activate after first commit.")
   177→		return NewSilentError(strategy.ErrEmptyRepository)
   178→	}
   179→
   180→	// Create session metadata folder using the entire session ID (preserves original date on resume)
   181→	// Use AbsPath to ensure we create at repo root, not relative to cwd
   182→	sessionDir := paths.SessionMetadataDirFromSessionID(sessionID)
   183→	sessionDirAbs, err := paths.AbsPath(sessionDir)
   184→	if err != nil {
   185→		sessionDirAbs = sessionDir // Fallback to relative
   186→	}
   187→	if err := os.MkdirAll(sessionDirAbs, 0o750); err != nil {
   188→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create session directory: %w", err)
   189→	}
   190→
   191→	// Wait for Claude Code to flush the transcript file.
   192→	// The stop hook fires before the transcript is fully written to disk.
   193→	// We poll for our own hook_progress sentinel entry in the file tail,
   194→	// which guarantees all prior entries have been flushed.
   195→	waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath, time.Now())
   196→
   197→	// Copy transcript
   198→	logFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.TranscriptFileName)
   199→	if err := copyFile(transcriptPath, logFile); err != nil {
   200→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to copy transcript: %w", err)
   201→	}
   202→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Copied transcript to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.TranscriptFileName)
   203→
   204→	// Load pre-prompt state (captured on UserPromptSubmit)
   205→	// Needed for transcript offset and file change detection
   206→	preState, err := LoadPrePromptState(sessionID)
   207→	if err != nil {
   208→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   209→	}
   210→
   211→	// Determine transcript offset: prefer pre-prompt state, fall back to session state.
   212→	// Pre-prompt state has the offset when the transcript path was available at prompt time.
   213→	// Session state has the offset updated after each successful checkpoint save (auto-commit).
   214→	var transcriptOffset int
   215→	if preState != nil && preState.StepTranscriptStart > 0 {
   216→		transcriptOffset = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   217→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   218→	} else {
   219→		// Fall back to session state (e.g., auto-commit strategy updates it after each save)
   220→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   221→		if loadErr != nil {
   222→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   223→		}
   224→		if sessionState != nil && sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart > 0 {
   225→			transcriptOffset = sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart
   226→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Session state found: parsing transcript from line %d\n", transcriptOffset)
   227→		}
   228→	}
   229→
   230→	// Parse transcript (optionally from offset for strategies that track transcript position)
   231→	// When transcriptOffset > 0, only parse NEW lines since the last checkpoint
   232→	var transcriptLines []transcriptLine
   233→	var totalLines int
   234→	if transcriptOffset > 0 {
   235→		// Parse only NEW lines since last checkpoint
   236→		transcriptLines, totalLines, err = transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset)
   237→		if err != nil {
   238→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript from line %d: %w", transcriptOffset, err)
   239→		}
   240→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Parsed %d new transcript lines (total: %d)\n", len(transcriptLines), totalLines)
   241→	} else {
   242→		// First prompt or no session state - parse entire transcript
   243→		// Use ParseFromFileAtLine with offset 0 to also get totalLines
   244→		transcriptLines, totalLines, err = transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(transcriptPath, 0)
   245→		if err != nil {
   246→			return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse transcript: %w", err)
   247→		}
   248→	}
   249→
   250→	// Extract all prompts since last checkpoint for prompt file
   251→	allPrompts := extractUserPrompts(transcriptLines)
   252→	promptFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.PromptFileName)
   253→	promptContent := strings.Join(allPrompts, "\n\n---\n\n")
   254→	if err := os.WriteFile(promptFile, []byte(promptContent), 0o600); err != nil {
   255→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write prompt file: %w", err)
   256→	}
   257→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted %d prompt(s) to: %s\n", len(allPrompts), sessionDir+"/"+paths.PromptFileName)
   258→
   259→	// Extract summary
   260→	summaryFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.SummaryFileName)
   261→	summary := extractLastAssistantMessage(transcriptLines)
   262→	if err := os.WriteFile(summaryFile, []byte(summary), 0o600); err != nil {
   263→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to write summary file: %w", err)
   264→	}
   265→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Extracted summary to: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.SummaryFileName)
   266→
   267→	// Get modified files from transcript (main agent + subagents).
   268→	// Subagent transcripts live in <transcriptDir>/<modelSessionID>/subagents/
   269→	subagentsDir := filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath), input.SessionID, "subagents")
   270→	modifiedFiles, subagentErr := claudecode.ExtractAllModifiedFiles(transcriptPath, transcriptOffset, subagentsDir)
   271→	if subagentErr != nil {
   272→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to extract modified files with subagents: %v\n", subagentErr)
   273→		// Fall back to main transcript only
   274→		modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(transcriptLines)
   275→	}
   276→
   277→	// Generate commit message from last user prompt
   278→	lastPrompt := ""
   279→	if len(allPrompts) > 0 {
   280→		lastPrompt = allPrompts[len(allPrompts)-1]
   281→	}
   282→	commitMessage := generateCommitMessage(lastPrompt)
   283→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Using commit message: %s\n", commitMessage)
   284→
   285→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   286→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   287→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   288→	if err != nil {
   289→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   290→	}
   291→
   292→	if preState != nil {
   293→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Pre-prompt state: %d pre-existing untracked files\n", len(preState.UntrackedFiles))
   294→	}
   295→
   296→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   297→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   298→	if err != nil {
   299→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   300→	}
   301→
   302→	// Filter and normalize all paths (CLI responsibility)
   303→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   304→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   305→	if changes != nil {
   306→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   307→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   308→	}
   309→
   310→	// Check if there are any changes to commit
   311→	totalChanges := len(relModifiedFiles) + len(relNewFiles) + len(relDeletedFiles)
   312→	if totalChanges == 0 {
   313→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "No files were modified during this session\n")
   314→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Skipping commit\n")
   315→		// Still transition phase even when skipping commit — the turn is ending.
   316→		transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   317→		// Auto-apply pending wingman review even when no file changes this turn
   318→		triggerWingmanAutoApplyIfPending(repoRoot)
   319→		// Clean up state even when skipping
   320→		if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   321→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   322→		}
   323→		outputWingmanStopNotification(repoRoot)
   324→		return nil
   325→	}
   326→
   327→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files modified during session (%d):\n", len(relModifiedFiles))
   328→	for _, file := range relModifiedFiles {
   329→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   330→	}
   331→	if len(relNewFiles) > 0 {
   332→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "New files created (%d):\n", len(relNewFiles))
   333→		for _, file := range relNewFiles {
   334→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  + %s\n", file)
   335→		}
   336→	}
   337→	if len(relDeletedFiles) > 0 {
   338→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Files deleted (%d):\n", len(relDeletedFiles))
   339→		for _, file := range relDeletedFiles {
   340→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "  - %s\n", file)
   341→		}
   342→	}
   343→
   344→	// Create context file before saving changes
   345→	contextFile := filepath.Join(sessionDirAbs, paths.ContextFileName)
   346→	if err := createContextFileMinimal(contextFile, commitMessage, sessionID, promptFile, summaryFile, transcriptLines); err != nil {
   347→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to create context file: %w", err)
   348→	}
   349→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Created context file: %s\n", sessionDir+"/"+paths.ContextFileName)
   350→
   351→	// Get git author from local/global config
   352→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   353→	if err != nil {
   354→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   355→	}
   356→
   357→	// Get the configured strategy
   358→	strat := GetStrategy()
   359→
   360→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   361→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   362→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   363→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   364→	}
   365→
   366→	// Get transcript position from pre-prompt state (captured at step/turn start)
   367→	var transcriptIdentifierAtStart string
   368→	var transcriptLinesAtStart int
   369→	if preState != nil {
   370→		transcriptIdentifierAtStart = preState.LastTranscriptIdentifier
   371→		transcriptLinesAtStart = preState.StepTranscriptStart
   372→	}
   373→
   374→	// Calculate token usage for this checkpoint (Claude Code specific)
   375→	var tokenUsage *agent.TokenUsage
   376→	if transcriptPath != "" {
   377→		usage, tokenErr := claudecode.CalculateTotalTokenUsage(transcriptPath, transcriptLinesAtStart, subagentsDir)
   378→		if tokenErr != nil {
   379→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to calculate token usage: %v\n", tokenErr)
   380→		} else {
   381→			tokenUsage = usage
   382→		}
   383→	}
   384→
   385→	// Build fully-populated save context and delegate to strategy
   386→	ctx := strategy.SaveContext{
   387→		SessionID:                sessionID,
   388→		ModifiedFiles:            relModifiedFiles,
   389→		NewFiles:                 relNewFiles,
   390→		DeletedFiles:             relDeletedFiles,
   391→		MetadataDir:              sessionDir,
   392→		MetadataDirAbs:           sessionDirAbs,
   393→		CommitMessage:            commitMessage,
   394→		TranscriptPath:           transcriptPath,
   395→		AuthorName:               author.Name,
   396→		AuthorEmail:              author.Email,
   397→		AgentType:                agentType,
   398→		StepTranscriptIdentifier: transcriptIdentifierAtStart,
   399→		StepTranscriptStart:      transcriptLinesAtStart,
   400→		TokenUsage:               tokenUsage,
   401→	}
   402→
   403→	if err := strat.SaveChanges(ctx); err != nil {
   404→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save changes: %w", err)
   405→	}
   406→
   407→	// Update session state with new transcript position for strategies that create
   408→	// commits on the active branch (auto-commit strategy). This prevents parsing old transcript
   409→	// lines on subsequent checkpoints.
   410→	// Note: Shadow strategy tracks transcript position per-step via StepTranscriptStart in
   411→	// pre-prompt state, but doesn't advance CheckpointTranscriptStart in session state because
   412→	// its checkpoints accumulate all files touched across the entire session.
   413→	if strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit {
   414→		// Load session state for updating transcript position
   415→		sessionState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   416→		if loadErr != nil {
   417→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state: %v\n", loadErr)
   418→		}
   419→		// Create session state lazily if it doesn't exist (backward compat for resumed sessions
   420→		// or if InitializeSession was never called/failed)
   421→		if sessionState == nil {
   422→			sessionState = &strategy.SessionState{
   423→				SessionID: sessionID,
   424→			}
   425→		}
   426→		sessionState.CheckpointTranscriptStart = totalLines
   427→		sessionState.StepCount++
   428→		if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(sessionState); updateErr != nil {
   429→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session state: %v\n", updateErr)
   430→		} else {
   431→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Updated session state: transcript position=%d, checkpoint=%d\n",
   432→				totalLines, sessionState.StepCount)
   433→		}
   434→	}
   435→
   436→	// Fire EventTurnEnd to transition session phase (all strategies).
   437→	// This moves ACTIVE → IDLE.
   438→	transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID)
   439→
   440→	// Trigger wingman review for auto-commit strategy (commit already happened
   441→	// in SaveChanges). Manual-commit triggers wingman from the git post-commit hook
   442→	// instead, since the user commits manually.
   443→	if totalChanges > 0 && strat.Name() == strategy.StrategyNameAutoCommit && settings.IsWingmanEnabled() {
   444→		triggerWingmanReview(WingmanPayload{
   445→			SessionID:     sessionID,
   446→			RepoRoot:      repoRoot,
   447→			ModifiedFiles: relModifiedFiles,
   448→			NewFiles:      relNewFiles,
   449→			DeletedFiles:  relDeletedFiles,
   450→			Prompts:       allPrompts,
   451→			CommitMessage: commitMessage,
   452→		})
   453→	}
   454→
   455→	// Auto-apply pending wingman review on turn end
   456→	triggerWingmanAutoApplyIfPending(repoRoot)
   457→
   458→	// Clean up pre-prompt state (CLI responsibility)
   459→	if err := CleanupPrePromptState(sessionID); err != nil {
   460→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to cleanup pre-prompt state: %v\n", err)
   461→	}
   462→
   463→	outputWingmanStopNotification(repoRoot)
   464→
   465→	return nil
   466→}
   467→
   468→// handleClaudeCodePostTodo handles the PostToolUse[TodoWrite] hook for subagent checkpoints.
   469→// Creates a checkpoint if we're in a subagent context (active pre-task file exists).
   470→// Skips silently if not in subagent context (main agent).
   471→func handleClaudeCodePostTodo() error {
   472→	input, err := parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(os.Stdin)
   473→	if err != nil {
   474→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[TodoWrite] input: %w", err)
   475→	}
   476→
   477→	// Get agent for logging context
   478→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   479→	if err != nil {
   480→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   481→	}
   482→
   483→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   484→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-todo",
   485→		slog.String("hook", "post-todo"),
   486→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   487→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   488→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   489→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   490→	)
   491→
   492→	// Check if we're in a subagent context by looking for an active pre-task file
   493→	taskToolUseID, found := FindActivePreTaskFile()
   494→	if !found {
   495→		// Not in subagent context - this is a main agent TodoWrite, skip
   496→		return nil
   497→	}
   498→
   499→	// Skip on default branch to avoid polluting main/master history
   500→	if skip, branchName := ShouldSkipOnDefaultBranch(); skip {
   501→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Entire: skipping incremental checkpoint on branch '%s'\n", branchName)
   502→		return nil
   503→	}
   504→
   505→	// Detect file changes since last checkpoint
   506→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(nil)
   507→	if err != nil {
   508→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to detect changed files: %v\n", err)
   509→		return nil
   510→	}
   511→
   512→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   513→	if len(changes.Modified) == 0 && len(changes.New) == 0 && len(changes.Deleted) == 0 {
   514→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping incremental checkpoint\n")
   515→		return nil
   516→	}
   517→
   518→	// Get git author
   519→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   520→	if err != nil {
   521→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to get git author: %v\n", err)
   522→		return nil
   523→	}
   524→
   525→	// Get the active strategy
   526→	strat := GetStrategy()
   527→
   528→	// Get the session ID from the transcript path or input, then transform to Entire session ID
   529→	sessionID := input.SessionID
   530→	if sessionID == "" {
   531→		sessionID = paths.ExtractSessionIDFromTranscriptPath(input.TranscriptPath)
   532→	}
   533→
   534→	// Get next checkpoint sequence
   535→	seq := GetNextCheckpointSequence(sessionID, taskToolUseID)
   536→
   537→	// Extract the todo content from the tool_input.
   538→	// PostToolUse receives the NEW todo list where the just-completed work is
   539→	// marked as "completed". The last completed item is the work that was just done.
   540→	todoContent := ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   541→	if todoContent == "" {
   542→		// No completed items - this is likely the first TodoWrite (planning phase).
   543→		// Check if there are any todos at all to avoid duplicate messages.
   544→		todoCount := CountTodosFromToolInput(input.ToolInput)
   545→		if todoCount > 0 {
   546→			// Use "Planning: N todos" format for the first TodoWrite
   547→			todoContent = fmt.Sprintf("Planning: %d todos", todoCount)
   548→		}
   549→		// If todoCount == 0, todoContent remains empty and FormatIncrementalMessage
   550→		// will fall back to "Checkpoint #N" format
   551→	}
   552→
   553→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   554→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   555→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   556→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   557→	}
   558→
   559→	// Build incremental checkpoint context
   560→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   561→		SessionID:           sessionID,
   562→		ToolUseID:           taskToolUseID,
   563→		ModifiedFiles:       changes.Modified,
   564→		NewFiles:            changes.New,
   565→		DeletedFiles:        changes.Deleted,
   566→		TranscriptPath:      input.TranscriptPath,
   567→		AuthorName:          author.Name,
   568→		AuthorEmail:         author.Email,
   569→		IsIncremental:       true,
   570→		IncrementalSequence: seq,
   571→		IncrementalType:     input.ToolName,
   572→		IncrementalData:     input.ToolInput,
   573→		TodoContent:         todoContent,
   574→		AgentType:           agentType,
   575→	}
   576→
   577→	// Save incremental checkpoint
   578→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   579→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to save incremental checkpoint: %v\n", err)
   580→		return nil
   581→	}
   582→
   583→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] Created incremental checkpoint #%d for %s (task: %s)\n",
   584→		seq, input.ToolName, taskToolUseID[:min(12, len(taskToolUseID))])
   585→	return nil
   586→}

   588→// handleClaudeCodePreTask handles the PreToolUse[Task] hook
   589→func handleClaudeCodePreTask() error {
   590→	input, err := parseTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   591→	if err != nil {
   592→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PreToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   593→	}
   594→
   595→	// Get agent for logging context
   596→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   597→	if err != nil {
   598→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   599→	}
   600→
   601→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   602→	logging.Info(logCtx, "pre-task",
   603→		slog.String("hook", "pre-task"),
   604→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   605→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   606→		slog.String("transcript_path", input.TranscriptPath),
   607→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   608→	)
   609→
   610→	// Log context to stdout
   611→	logPreTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input)
   612→
   613→	// Capture pre-task state locally (for computing new files when task completes).
   614→	// We don't create a shadow branch commit here. Commits are created during
   615→	// task completion (handleClaudeCodePostTask/handleClaudeCodePostTodo) only if the task resulted
   616→	// in file changes.
   617→	if err := CapturePreTaskState(input.ToolUseID); err != nil {
   618→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to capture pre-task state: %w", err)
   619→	}
   620→
   621→	return nil
   622→}

   624→// handleClaudeCodePostTask handles the PostToolUse[Task] hook
   625→func handleClaudeCodePostTask() error {
   626→	input, err := parsePostTaskHookInput(os.Stdin)
   627→	if err != nil {
   628→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse PostToolUse[Task] input: %w", err)
   629→	}
   630→
   631→	// Extract subagent type from tool_input for logging
   632→	subagentType, taskDescription := ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(input.ToolInput)
   633→
   634→	// Get agent for logging context
   635→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   636→	if err != nil {
   637→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   638→	}
   639→
   640→	// Log parsed input context
   641→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   642→	logging.Info(logCtx, "post-task",
   643→		slog.String("hook", "post-task"),
   644→		slog.String("hook_type", "subagent"),
   645→		slog.String("tool_use_id", input.ToolUseID),
   646→		slog.String("agent_id", input.AgentID),
   647→		slog.String("subagent_type", subagentType),
   648→	)
   649→
   650→	// Determine subagent transcript path
   651→	transcriptDir := filepath.Dir(input.TranscriptPath)
   652→	var subagentTranscriptPath string
   653→	if input.AgentID != "" {
   654→		subagentTranscriptPath = AgentTranscriptPath(transcriptDir, input.AgentID)
   655→		if !fileExists(subagentTranscriptPath) {
   656→			subagentTranscriptPath = ""
   657→		}
   658→	}
   659→
   660→	// Log context to stdout
   661→	logPostTaskHookContext(os.Stdout, input, subagentTranscriptPath)
   662→
   663→	// Parse transcript to extract modified files
   664→	var modifiedFiles []string
   665→	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
   666→		// Use subagent transcript if available
   667→		parsed, _, parseErr := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(subagentTranscriptPath, 0)
   668→		if parseErr != nil {
   669→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse subagent transcript: %v\n", parseErr)
   670→		} else {
   671→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(parsed)
   672→		}
   673→	} else {
   674→		// Fall back to main transcript
   675→		parsed, _, parseErr := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(input.TranscriptPath, 0)
   676→		if parseErr != nil {
   677→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to parse transcript: %v\n", parseErr)
   678→		} else {
   679→			modifiedFiles = extractModifiedFiles(parsed)
   680→		}
   681→	}
   682→
   683→	// Load pre-task state and compute new files
   684→	preState, err := LoadPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID)
   685→	if err != nil {
   686→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load pre-task state: %v\n", err)
   687→	}
   688→
   689→	// Compute new and deleted files (single git status call)
   690→	changes, err := DetectFileChanges(preState.PreUntrackedFiles())
   691→	if err != nil {
   692→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to compute file changes: %v\n", err)
   693→	}
   694→
   695→	// Get repo root for path conversion (not cwd, since Claude may be in a subdirectory)
   696→	// Using cwd would filter out files in sibling directories (paths starting with ..)
   697→	repoRoot, err := paths.RepoRoot()
   698→	if err != nil {
   699→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get repo root: %w", err)
   700→	}
   701→
   702→	// Filter and normalize paths
   703→	relModifiedFiles := FilterAndNormalizePaths(modifiedFiles, repoRoot)
   704→	var relNewFiles, relDeletedFiles []string
   705→	if changes != nil {
   706→		relNewFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.New, repoRoot)
   707→		relDeletedFiles = FilterAndNormalizePaths(changes.Deleted, repoRoot)
   708→	}
   709→
   710→	// If no file changes, skip creating a checkpoint
   711→	if len(relModifiedFiles) == 0 && len(relNewFiles) == 0 && len(relDeletedFiles) == 0 {
   712→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[entire] No file changes detected, skipping task checkpoint\n")
   713→		// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   714→		_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   715→		return nil
   716→	}
   717→
   718→	// Find checkpoint UUID from main transcript (best-effort, ignore errors)
   719→	mainLines, _, _ := transcript.ParseFromFileAtLine(input.TranscriptPath, 0) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort extraction
   720→	checkpointUUID, _ := FindCheckpointUUID(mainLines, input.ToolUseID)
   721→
   722→	// Get git author
   723→	author, err := GetGitAuthor()
   724→	if err != nil {
   725→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get git author: %w", err)
   726→	}
   727→
   728→	// Get the configured strategy
   729→	strat := GetStrategy()
   730→
   731→	// Get agent type from the currently executing hook agent (authoritative source)
   732→	var agentType agent.AgentType
   733→	if hookAgent, agentErr := GetCurrentHookAgent(); agentErr == nil {
   734→		agentType = hookAgent.Type()
   735→	}
   736→
   737→	// Build task checkpoint context - strategy handles metadata creation
   738→	// Note: Incremental checkpoints are now created during task execution via handleClaudeCodePostTodo,
   739→	// so we don't need to collect/cleanup staging area here.
   740→	ctx := strategy.TaskCheckpointContext{
   741→		SessionID:              input.SessionID,
   742→		ToolUseID:              input.ToolUseID,
   743→		AgentID:                input.AgentID,
   744→		ModifiedFiles:          relModifiedFiles,
   745→		NewFiles:               relNewFiles,
   746→		DeletedFiles:           relDeletedFiles,
   747→		TranscriptPath:         input.TranscriptPath,
   748→		SubagentTranscriptPath: subagentTranscriptPath,
   749→		CheckpointUUID:         checkpointUUID,
   750→		AuthorName:             author.Name,
   751→		AuthorEmail:            author.Email,
   752→		SubagentType:           subagentType,
   753→		TaskDescription:        taskDescription,
   754→		AgentType:              agentType,
   755→	}
   756→
   757→	// Call strategy to save task checkpoint - strategy handles all metadata creation
   758→	if err := strat.SaveTaskCheckpoint(ctx); err != nil {
   759→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save task checkpoint: %w", err)
   760→	}
   761→
   762→	// Cleanup pre-task state (ignore error - cleanup is best-effort)
   763→	_ = CleanupPreTaskState(input.ToolUseID) //nolint:errcheck // best-effort cleanup
   764→
   765→	return nil
   766→}

   773→// handleClaudeCodeSessionEnd handles the SessionEnd hook for Claude Code.
   774→// This fires when the user explicitly closes the session.
   775→// Updates the session state with EndedAt timestamp.
   776→func handleClaudeCodeSessionEnd() error {
   777→	ag, err := GetCurrentHookAgent()
   778→	if err != nil {
   779→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to get agent: %w", err)
   780→	}
   781→
   782→	input, err := ag.ParseHookInput(agent.HookSessionEnd, os.Stdin)
   783→	if err != nil {
   784→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to parse hook input: %w", err)
   785→	}
   786→
   787→	logCtx := logging.WithAgent(logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks"), ag.Name())
   788→	logging.Info(logCtx, "session-end",
   789→		slog.String("hook", "session-end"),
   790→		slog.String("hook_type", "agent"),
   791→		slog.String("model_session_id", input.SessionID),
   792→	)
   793→
   794→	if input.SessionID == "" {
   795→		return nil // No session to update
   796→	}
   797→
   798→	// Best-effort cleanup - don't block session closure on failure
   799→	if err := markSessionEnded(input.SessionID); err != nil {
   800→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to mark session ended: %v\n", err)
   801→	}
   802→
   803→	return nil
   804→}
   805→
   806→// wingmanNotificationLockThreshold is the maximum lock file age for showing
   807→// "Reviewing your changes..." notifications. Much tighter than staleLockThreshold
   808→// (used for lock acquisition) because a real review takes at most
   809→// wingmanInitialDelay (10s) + wingmanReviewTimeout (5m) ≈ 6 minutes.
   810→// A lock older than this is almost certainly stale for notification purposes.
   811→const wingmanNotificationLockThreshold = 10 * time.Minute
   812→
   813→// outputWingmanStopNotification outputs a systemMessage notification about
   814→// wingman status at the end of a stop hook. This makes wingman activity visible
   815→// in the agent terminal without injecting context into the agent's conversation.
   816→// Best-effort: status may be stale due to concurrent wingman processes.
   817→func outputWingmanStopNotification(repoRoot string) {
   818→	if !settings.IsWingmanEnabled() {
   819→		return
   820→	}
   821→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_WINGMAN_APPLY") != "" {
   822→		return
   823→	}
   824→
   825→	lockPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, wingmanLockFile)
   826→	if info, err := os.Stat(lockPath); err == nil && time.Since(info.ModTime()) <= wingmanNotificationLockThreshold {
   827→		_ = outputHookMessage("[Wingman] Reviewing your changes...") //nolint:errcheck // best-effort notification
   828→		return
   829→	}
   830→
   831→	reviewPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, wingmanReviewFile)
   832→	if _, err := os.Stat(reviewPath); err == nil {
   833→		_ = outputHookMessage("[Wingman] Review pending \u2014 will be addressed on your next prompt") //nolint:errcheck // best-effort notification
   834→		return
   835→	}
   836→}
   837→
   838→// transitionSessionTurnEnd fires EventTurnEnd to move the session from
   839→// ACTIVE → IDLE. Best-effort: logs warnings on failure rather than
   840→// returning errors.
   841→func transitionSessionTurnEnd(sessionID string) {
   842→	turnState, loadErr := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   843→	if loadErr != nil {
   844→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to load session state for turn end: %v\n", loadErr)
   845→		return
   846→	}
   847→	if turnState == nil {
   848→		return
   849→	}
   850→	if err := strategy.TransitionAndLog(turnState, session.EventTurnEnd, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); err != nil {
   851→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: turn-end transition failed: %v\n", err)
   852→	}
   853→
   854→	// Always dispatch to strategy for turn-end handling. The strategy reads
   855→	// work items from state (e.g. TurnCheckpointIDs), not the action list.
   856→	strat := GetStrategy()
   857→	if handler, ok := strat.(strategy.TurnEndHandler); ok {
   858→		if err := handler.HandleTurnEnd(turnState); err != nil {
   859→			fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: turn-end action dispatch failed: %v\n", err)
   860→		}
   861→	}
   862→
   863→	if updateErr := strategy.SaveSessionState(turnState); updateErr != nil {
   864→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: failed to update session phase on turn end: %v\n", updateErr)
   865→	}
   866→}
   867→
   868→// triggerWingmanAutoApplyIfPending checks for a pending REVIEW.md and spawns
   869→// the auto-apply subprocess if conditions are met. Called from the stop hook
   870→// on every turn end (both with-changes and no-changes paths).
   871→//
   872→// When a live session exists, this is a no-op: the prompt-submit injection
   873→// will deliver the review visibly in the user's terminal instead. Background
   874→// auto-apply is only used when no sessions are alive (all ended).
   875→func triggerWingmanAutoApplyIfPending(repoRoot string) {
   876→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "wingman")
   877→	if !settings.IsWingmanEnabled() {
   878→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply skip: wingman not enabled")
   879→		return
   880→	}
   881→	if os.Getenv("ENTIRE_WINGMAN_APPLY") != "" {
   882→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply skip: already in apply subprocess")
   883→		return
   884→	}
   885→	reviewPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, wingmanReviewFile)
   886→	if _, statErr := os.Stat(reviewPath); statErr != nil {
   887→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply skip: no REVIEW.md pending")
   888→		return
   889→	}
   890→	wingmanState := loadWingmanStateDirect(repoRoot)
   891→	if wingmanState != nil && wingmanState.ApplyAttemptedAt != nil {
   892→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply already attempted, skipping",
   893→			slog.Time("attempted_at", *wingmanState.ApplyAttemptedAt),
   894→		)
   895→		return
   896→	}
   897→	// Don't spawn background auto-apply if a live session exists.
   898→	// The prompt-submit hook will inject REVIEW.md as additionalContext,
   899→	// which is visible to the user in their terminal.
   900→	if hasAnyLiveSession(repoRoot) {
   901→		logging.Debug(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply deferred: live session will handle via injection")
   902→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Review pending — will be injected on next prompt\n")
   903→		return
   904→	}
   905→	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "[wingman] Pending review found, spawning auto-apply (no live sessions)\n")
   906→	logging.Info(logCtx, "wingman auto-apply spawning (no live sessions)",
   907→		slog.String("review_path", reviewPath),
   908→	)
   909→	spawnDetachedWingmanApply(repoRoot)
   910→}
   911→
   912→// markSessionEnded transitions the session to ENDED phase via the state machine.
   913→func markSessionEnded(sessionID string) error {
   914→	state, err := strategy.LoadSessionState(sessionID)
   915→	if err != nil {
   916→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to load session state: %w", err)
   917→	}
   918→	if state == nil {
   919→		return nil // No state file, nothing to update
   920→	}
   921→
   922→	if transErr := strategy.TransitionAndLog(state, session.EventSessionStop, session.TransitionContext{}, session.NoOpActionHandler{}); transErr != nil {
   923→		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "Warning: session stop transition failed: %v\n", transErr)
   924→	}
   925→
   926→	now := time.Now()
   927→	state.EndedAt = &now
   928→
   929→	if err := strategy.SaveSessionState(state); err != nil {
   930→		return fmt.Errorf("failed to save session state: %w", err)
   931→	}
   932→	return nil
   933→}
   934→
   935→// stopHookSentinel is the string that appears in Claude Code's hook_progress
   936→// transcript entry when it launches our stop hook. Used to detect that the
   937→// transcript file has been fully flushed before we copy it.
   938→const stopHookSentinel = "hooks claude-code stop"
   939→
   940→// waitForTranscriptFlush polls the transcript file tail for the hook_progress
   941→// sentinel entry that Claude Code writes when launching the stop hook.
   942→// Once this entry appears in the file, all prior entries (assistant replies,
   943→// tool results) are guaranteed to have been flushed.
   944→//
   945→// hookStartTime is the approximate time our process started, used to avoid
   946→// matching stale sentinel entries from previous stop hook invocations.
   947→//
   948→// Falls back silently after a timeout — the transcript copy will proceed
   949→// with whatever data is available.
   950→func waitForTranscriptFlush(transcriptPath string, hookStartTime time.Time) {
   951→	const (
   952→		maxWait      = 3 * time.Second
   953→		pollInterval = 50 * time.Millisecond
   954→		tailBytes    = 4096 // Read last 4KB — sentinel is near the end
   955→		maxSkew      = 2 * time.Second
   956→	)
   957→
   958→	logCtx := logging.WithComponent(context.Background(), "hooks")
   959→	deadline := time.Now().Add(maxWait)
   960→	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
   961→		if checkStopSentinel(transcriptPath, tailBytes, hookStartTime, maxSkew) {
   962→			logging.Debug(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel found",
   963→				slog.Duration("wait", time.Since(hookStartTime)),
   964→			)
   965→			return
   966→		}
   967→		time.Sleep(pollInterval)
   968→	}
   969→	// Timeout — proceed with whatever is on disk.
   970→	logging.Warn(logCtx, "transcript flush sentinel not found within timeout, proceeding",
   971→		slog.Duration("timeout", maxWait),
   972→	)
   973→}
   974→
   975→// checkStopSentinel reads the tail of the transcript file and looks for a
   976→// hook_progress entry containing the stop hook sentinel, with a timestamp
   977→// close to hookStartTime.
   978→func checkStopSentinel(path string, tailBytes int64, hookStartTime time.Time, maxSkew time.Duration) bool {
   979→	f, err := os.Open(path) //nolint:gosec // path comes from agent hook input
   980→	if err != nil {
   981→		return false
   982→	}
   983→	defer f.Close()
   984→
   985→	// Seek to tail
   986→	info, err := f.Stat()
   987→	if err != nil {
   988→		return false
   989→	}
   990→	offset := info.Size() - tailBytes
   991→	if offset < 0 {
   992→		offset = 0
   993→	}
   994→	buf := make([]byte, info.Size()-offset)
   995→	if _, err := f.ReadAt(buf, offset); err != nil {
   996→		return false
   997→	}
   998→
   999→	// Scan lines from the tail for the sentinel
  1000→	lines := strings.Split(string(buf), "\n")
  1001→	for _, line := range lines {
  1002→		line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
  1003→		if line == "" || !strings.Contains(line, stopHookSentinel) {
  1004→			continue
  1005→		}
  1006→
  1007→		// Parse timestamp to check recency
  1008→		var entry struct {
  1009→			Timestamp string `json:"timestamp"`
  1010→		}
  1011→		if json.Unmarshal([]byte(line), &entry) != nil || entry.Timestamp == "" {
  1012→			continue
  1013→		}
  1014→		ts, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339Nano, entry.Timestamp)
  1015→		if err != nil {
  1016→			ts, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, entry.Timestamp)
  1017→			if err != nil {
  1018→				continue
  1019→			}
  1020→		}
  1021→
  1022→		// Check timestamp is within skew window of our start time
  1023→		if ts.After(hookStartTime.Add(-maxSkew)) && ts.Before(hookStartTime.Add(maxSkew)) {
  1024→			return true
  1025→		}
  1026→	}
  1027→	return false
  1028→}
  1029→

package cli

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"

	"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/strategy"
)

// TaskHookInput represents the JSON input from PreToolUse[Task] hook
type TaskHookInput struct {
	SessionID      string          `json:"session_id"`
	TranscriptPath string          `json:"transcript_path"`
	ToolUseID      string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
	ToolInput      json.RawMessage `json:"tool_input"`
}

// postTaskHookInputRaw is the raw JSON structure from PostToolUse[Task] hook
type postTaskHookInputRaw struct {
	SessionID      string          `json:"session_id"`
	TranscriptPath string          `json:"transcript_path"`
	ToolUseID      string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
	ToolInput      json.RawMessage `json:"tool_input"`
	ToolResponse   struct {
		AgentID string `json:"agentId"`
	} `json:"tool_response"`
}

// PostTaskHookInput represents the parsed input from PostToolUse[Task] hook
type PostTaskHookInput struct {
	TaskHookInput

	AgentID   string          // Extracted from tool_response.agentId
	ToolInput json.RawMessage // Raw tool input for reference
}

// parseTaskHookInput parses PreToolUse[Task] hook input from reader
func parseTaskHookInput(r io.Reader) (*TaskHookInput, error) {
	data, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read input: %w", err)
	}

	if len(data) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("empty input")
	}

	var input TaskHookInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &input); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse JSON: %w", err)
	}

	return &input, nil
}

// parsePostTaskHookInput parses PostToolUse[Task] hook input from reader
func parsePostTaskHookInput(r io.Reader) (*PostTaskHookInput, error) {
	data, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read input: %w", err)
	}

	if len(data) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("empty input")
	}

	var raw postTaskHookInputRaw
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &raw); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse JSON: %w", err)
	}

	return &PostTaskHookInput{
		TaskHookInput: TaskHookInput{
			SessionID:      raw.SessionID,
			TranscriptPath: raw.TranscriptPath,
			ToolUseID:      raw.ToolUseID,
		},
		AgentID:   raw.ToolResponse.AgentID,
		ToolInput: raw.ToolInput,
	}, nil
}

// logPreTaskHookContext logs the PreToolUse[Task] hook context to the writer
func logPreTaskHookContext(w io.Writer, input *TaskHookInput) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w, "[entire] PreToolUse[Task] hook invoked")
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Session ID: %s\n", input.SessionID)
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Tool Use ID: %s\n", input.ToolUseID)
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Transcript: %s\n", input.TranscriptPath)
}

// SubagentCheckpointHookInput represents the JSON input from PostToolUse hooks for
// subagent checkpoint creation (TodoWrite, Edit, Write)
type SubagentCheckpointHookInput struct {
	SessionID      string          `json:"session_id"`
	TranscriptPath string          `json:"transcript_path"`
	ToolName       string          `json:"tool_name"`
	ToolUseID      string          `json:"tool_use_id"`
	ToolInput      json.RawMessage `json:"tool_input"`
	ToolResponse   json.RawMessage `json:"tool_response"`
}

// parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput parses PostToolUse hook input for subagent checkpoints
func parseSubagentCheckpointHookInput(r io.Reader) (*SubagentCheckpointHookInput, error) {
	data, err := io.ReadAll(r)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to read input: %w", err)
	}

	if len(data) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("empty input")
	}

	var input SubagentCheckpointHookInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &input); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to parse JSON: %w", err)
	}

	return &input, nil
}

// taskToolInput represents the tool_input structure for the Task tool.
// Used to extract subagent_type and description for descriptive commit messages.
type taskToolInput struct {
	SubagentType string `json:"subagent_type"`
	Description  string `json:"description"`
}

// ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription extracts subagent_type and description from Task tool_input.
// Returns empty strings if parsing fails or fields are not present.
func ParseSubagentTypeAndDescription(toolInput json.RawMessage) (agentType, description string) {
	if len(toolInput) == 0 {
		return "", ""
	}

	var input taskToolInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal(toolInput, &input); err != nil {
		return "", ""
	}

	return input.SubagentType, input.Description
}

// todoWriteToolInput represents the tool_input structure for the TodoWrite tool.
// Used to extract the todos array which is then passed to strategy.ExtractInProgressTodo.
type todoWriteToolInput struct {
	Todos json.RawMessage `json:"todos"`
}

// ExtractTodoContentFromToolInput extracts the content of the in-progress todo item from TodoWrite tool_input.
// Falls back to the first pending item if no in-progress item is found.
// Returns empty string if no suitable item is found or JSON is invalid.
//
// This function unwraps the outer tool_input object to extract the todos array,
// then delegates to strategy.ExtractInProgressTodo for the actual parsing logic.
func ExtractTodoContentFromToolInput(toolInput json.RawMessage) string {
	if len(toolInput) == 0 {
		return ""
	}

	// First extract the todos array from tool_input
	var input todoWriteToolInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal(toolInput, &input); err != nil {
		return ""
	}

	// Delegate to strategy package for the actual extraction logic
	return strategy.ExtractInProgressTodo(input.Todos)
}

// ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput extracts the content of the last completed todo item.
// In PostToolUse[TodoWrite], the tool_input contains the NEW todo list where the
// just-finished work is marked as "completed". The last completed item represents
// the work that was just done.
//
// Returns empty string if no completed items exist or JSON is invalid.
func ExtractLastCompletedTodoFromToolInput(toolInput json.RawMessage) string {
	if len(toolInput) == 0 {
		return ""
	}

	// First extract the todos array from tool_input
	var input todoWriteToolInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal(toolInput, &input); err != nil {
		return ""
	}

	// Delegate to strategy package for the actual extraction logic
	return strategy.ExtractLastCompletedTodo(input.Todos)
}

// CountTodosFromToolInput returns the number of todo items in the TodoWrite tool_input.
// Returns 0 if the JSON is invalid or empty.
//
// This function unwraps the outer tool_input object to extract the todos array,
// then delegates to strategy.CountTodos for the actual count.
func CountTodosFromToolInput(toolInput json.RawMessage) int {
	if len(toolInput) == 0 {
		return 0
	}

	// First extract the todos array from tool_input
	var input todoWriteToolInput
	if err := json.Unmarshal(toolInput, &input); err != nil {
		return 0
	}

	// Delegate to strategy package for the actual count
	return strategy.CountTodos(input.Todos)
}

// logPostTaskHookContext logs the PostToolUse[Task] hook context to the writer
func logPostTaskHookContext(w io.Writer, input *PostTaskHookInput, subagentTranscriptPath string) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w, "[entire] PostToolUse[Task] hook invoked")
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Session ID: %s\n", input.SessionID)
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Tool Use ID: %s\n", input.ToolUseID)

	if input.AgentID != "" {
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Agent ID: %s\n", input.AgentID)
	} else {
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w, "  Agent ID: (none)")
	}

	_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Transcript: %s\n", input.TranscriptPath)

	if subagentTranscriptPath != "" {
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "  Subagent Transcript: %s\n", subagentTranscriptPath)
	} else {
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(w, "  Subagent Transcript: (none)")
	}
}

// hookResponse represents a JSON response.
// Used to control whether Agent continues processing the prompt.
type hookResponse struct {
	SystemMessage string `json:"systemMessage,omitempty"`
}

// outputHookResponse outputs a JSON response to stdout
func outputHookResponse(reason string) error {
	resp := hookResponse{
		SystemMessage: reason,
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(resp); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to encode hook response: %w", err)
	}
	return nil
}
